integrity: A complete elementary two-regime upper bound, explicit matching factorizations, and an independently executable finite checker accompany the claim. Small-length checks are not used in place of the asymptotic proof.
scientific_limitations: Positive binary free-semigroup endomorphisms with both generator images of the same length; only sharp exponential bases, not leading constants or exact general counts. The result does not address alphabets of more than two letters or nonuniform image lengths; historical priority is not independently certified.
title: A parity split in the exponential abundance of reducible binary uniform endomorphisms
